Anthony Raftery ( 1784-1835) wrote of her in "Mary Hynes, or The Posy
Bright," in Songs Ascribed to Raftery, ed. Douglas Hyde ( 1903). Yeats described
her in "Dust Hath Closed Helen's Eye," a story added to the 1902 edition
of The Celtic Twilight.
